text:
Jordan Henderson, 36, scored twice and set up another in Chelsea's 5-1 win over Bournemouth: his first goals for the club. The oldest player to do that in a Premier League game since Cristiano Ronaldo in 2022. Best 36-year-old you've ever seen? 👇
#Henderson #Chelsea #PremierLeague #CFC #Football
titulo: Jordan Henderson, 36, scores twice for Chelsea: oldest to do it since Ronaldo
